name: Date at the Cemetery
source:
Sometimes, dating in Colorado felt harder than it had any right to be. You’d searched in places no one should ever have to search, like speed dating with a guy who looked twice your age or the endless void of dead-end dating apps.

You had tried everything! And were almost ready to give up. That was… until that night. Some overrated, overpriced warehouse party with bad lighting and ear-deafening music. Sure, it wasn’t exactly your scene, but your friends had practically dragged you there. And after a messy breakup and faaaaar too many nights spent single….you were getting desperate. 

And that’s how you met Avon…
